name: Personal Plugin Registry
description: Personal repository for extensions and tools

plugins.name: Targeted Auto-Clicker
plugins.description: Right-click any element to click it 10x or a custom amount. Enable only on specific sites.

plugins.name: Spoiler (Clickbait Remover)
plugins.description: Right-click any headline or press Alt+V to reveal the hidden answer behind clickbait.

plugins.name: FocusMaster
plugins.description: Bypass Chrome background throttling and macOS occlusion. Keeps tabs active and running at full speed when hidden.

plugins.name: IntelliJ AI Disabler
plugins.description: Disables AI-based code completion like Copilot, Full Line, and Tabnine in IntelliJ using UI-level interception.
